app.name: Agent Platform
app.description: A secure AI assistant running inside your organization's infrastructure

auth.title: Welcome to Agent Platform
auth.description: Sign in with your organization account to start a conversation with the assistant.
auth.callbackFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.

chat.emptyTitle: How can I help you today?
chat.emptyHint: Ask a question and the assistant will answer right away.
chat.composerHint: Press <key>Enter</key> to send and <key>Shift+Enter</key> for a new line.
chat.stopped: Answer generation stopped at your request.
chat.sendWaiting: Wait until the attached files are processed.

memory.title: Assistant memory
memory.description: The assistant saves what is worth remembering about you from your conversations, such as your preferences and work context, and uses it in later conversations. This memory is yours alone.
memory.enabledHint: Memory is on: the assistant saves what is worth remembering and uses it in its answers.
memory.disabledHint: Memory is off: the assistant saves nothing new and does not use what was saved. Saved items stay until you delete them.
memory.empty: Nothing is saved in your memory.
memory.deleted: The item was deleted from your memory.

errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this request.
errors.kb_forbidden: You do not have access to one of the selected knowledge bases.
errors.conversation_forbidden: This conversation belongs to another user, so you cannot continue it.
errors.invalid_request: The request could not be processed because it is invalid.
errors.agent_unavailable: The assistant service is currently unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.agent_stream_interrupted: The answer stream was interrupted before it finished. Please try again.
errors.audit_unavailable: Your request could not be recorded in the audit log, so it was not carried out. Please try again shortly.
errors.turn_failed: The answer to your question could not be completed.
errors.capability_failed: A capability could not complete, so the answer was not produced.
errors.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your network connection.
errors.not_found: The requested resource was not found.
errors.no_capability_available: No capability available to you can handle this request.
errors.context_overflow: The request is too long for the model to process.
errors.model_unavailable: The language model is currently unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.validation_failed: The answer did not pass verification, so it was not shown.
errors.output_blocked: The answer was withheld by a content policy.
errors.data_blocked: The answer was withheld because it contains protected data.
errors.memory_not_found: This item was not found in your memory; it may already have been deleted.
errors.turn_in_flight: Your earlier request in this conversation is still being processed. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.service_busy: The service is busy with other requests right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.input_blocked: The request was not carried out under a content policy.
errors.guard_unavailable: The protection policies could not be checked right now, so the request was not completed. Please try again shortly.
errors.policy_not_found: This policy was not found; it may have been removed or its id changed.
errors.policy_exists: A policy with this id already exists. Choose another id or save it as a new version.
errors.policy_invalid: The policy is invalid. See the details below.
errors.identity_unavailable: The identity service could not be reached right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.attachment_not_found: This file was not found in the conversation.
errors.attachment_limit: The conversation already holds the maximum number of files.
errors.file_too_large: The file is larger than the allowed size.
errors.upload_rate_limited: Too many files were uploaded in the last minute. Wait a little, then try again.
errors.too_many_pages: The file has more pages than allowed.
errors.file_type_unsupported: This file type is not supported. Supported types: PDF, Word, Excel, text and Markdown.
errors.storage_unavailable: The file storage is unavailable. Please try again shortly.

policies.title: Guard policies
policies.description: These policies control what enters the assistant, what leaves it and what is stored in memory, at the seven checkpoints. Every edit is saved as a new version and reaches every server within two seconds, without a restart.
policies.select: Choose a policy from the list to view and test it, or create a new one.
policies.saved: The policy was saved; the current version is {version}.
policies.configInvalid: The advanced settings text is not valid, so saving is blocked.

fields.groupHint: A narrower policy overrides the global one of its group. Leave it empty to make the id the group.
fields.unknownRole: Warning: this role is not in the list of policy roles now:

scopeHints.tenant: The tenant id as the sign-in token carries it.
scopeHints.role: Applies to holders of the chosen policy role.

fields.noRoles: No policy roles are defined yet.

test.title: Test the policy
test.storedNote: Tests the saved current version, on or off. Nothing is recorded.
test.draftNote: Tests the current draft before it is saved. Nothing is recorded.
test.placeholder: Type a sample text, such as a fake mobile number…

io.title: Import and export
io.report: {created} created, {versioned} given a new version, {switched} switched, {unchanged} unchanged.

editor.keywordPlaceholder: Type a keyword and press Enter

errors.patternName: The name is Latin letters, digits or underscores, up to 64 characters.
errors.threshold: The value is between zero and one.

attachments.dropHere: Drop files here to attach them
attachments.limits: Up to {files} files per conversation, {size} MB per file and {pages} pages per PDF. Types: {types}.

reasons.scanned_unsupported: The file is a scanned image with no readable text; reading images is not supported yet.
reasons.too_many_pages: The file has more pages than allowed.
reasons.unsupported_type: The file's content does not match its type, or its type is not supported.
reasons.corrupt_file: The file is damaged and cannot be opened.
reasons.storage_unavailable: The file storage could not be reached.
reasons.embedding_unavailable: The file could not be indexed now. Upload it again shortly.
reasons.ingest_error: An unexpected error occurred while reading the file.
reasons.file_too_large: The file is larger than the allowed size.
reasons.archive_unsafe: The file's structure is unsafe or larger than allowed, so it was not read.
reasons.xml_unsafe: The file contains declarations that are not allowed, so it was not read.
reasons.stream_too_large: The file holds compressed content larger than allowed, so it was not read.
reasons.text_too_long: The file's text is longer than the allowed limit.
reasons.too_many_chunks: The file is too large to be indexed whole.
reasons.extraction_aborted: Reading the file took more time or memory than allowed, so it was stopped.
reasons.unknown: The file could not be read.
